messages:
maria: did anyone actually get paged for the api-gateway 5xx spike ~5m ago? I only saw logs, no phone or slack page :thinking:
jonathan: i did not. I got the alert in the monitoring dashboard but no page to my phone.
sara: same here — i was active in slack but no incident DM or mobile page.
incident-bot: ALERT: api-gateway P1 detected (error-rate > 8% for 2min). Routing policy: ops -> pager-proxy. Attempting handoff to oncall (rotation: jonathan -> emily).
maria: incident-bot says it routed but ops-pager-proxy might be the problem. @ops-pager-proxy any logs?
ops-pager-proxy: ERROR forwarding to PagerBridge: 502 Bad Gateway (connect timeout). payload id=6b9f
jonathan: that matches — i see a failed webhook retry in PagerBridge UI for payload 6b9f. status 502.
emily: @maria @jonathan i was supposed to be oncall but i didn't get notified. Did we have a suppression window set?
sara: checking rotation audit: last manual silence created by jules at 11:02 UTC for 30m (reason: noisy test). It should have expired.
jonathan: can someone run a quick healthcheck on the proxy? i'm going to try `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=ops-pager-proxy`
maria: thanks — i see proxy pod `ops-pager-proxy-5c8d7` OOMKilled 2m ago and restarted. logs show:
```
E0215 11:14:22.123 forwarding.go:87] failed to post to pagerbridge: Post "https://pagerbridge.redwood.io/v1/push": dial tcp 10.12.34.56:443: connect: connection refused
E0215 11:14:22.123 forwarder: retrying (attempt 3)
```
jonathan: that would explain the 502s. looks like pager-proxy couldn't establish outbound TLS to pagerbridge. maybe egress rule changed?
emily: our recent firewall change last night added deny rule for 10.12.0.0/16 outbound from infra namespace — ops ticket #INC-834. Might've blocked pagerbridge IPs.
sara: ok, immediate plan: if proxy can't talk out we need to page manually. who can call the oncall roster? i'll DM the entire oncall list and call the primary.
maria: i've manually called emily and voicemail. left message. i'll also trigger the fallback route in the console (emergency-phone).
incident-bot: ADMIN ACTION: manual fallback invoked by maria — triggering emergency-phone route.
ops-pager-proxy: INFO connection test to https://pagerbridge.redwood.io success after restart at 11:18 UTC. latency 210ms.
jonathan: i just got the emergency-phone page. paging is working now (via fallback).
emily: phone woke me — i'm online. i'm going to run a quick egress check then remove the deny rule from firewall and coordinate with infra.
jonathan: for immediate mitigation i've redeployed ops-pager-proxy with env var `DISABLE_CONNECTION_POOL=1` to avoid stale sockets while we fix firewall. deploy log: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/ops-pager-proxy -n infra`
maria: good call. let's confirm retries went through for the original payloads. pagerbridge shows successful delivery for 6b9f and 6ba2 after 11:19.
sara: can someone file a temporary runbook note — if ops-pager-proxy restarts or OOMs mid-incident, trigger emergency-phone fallback and call the oncall directly. i'll add it to /runbooks/incidents/paging.md
emaria: also request to infra: please add an alert for proxy restarts + outbound error-rate so we don't lose paging silently. pinging @jonathan for follow-up.
emuel: (reaction) :thumbsup:
jonathan: follow-ups: 1) roll back the firewall deny for pagerbridge subnet (infra ticket), 2) add redundancy route to use direct pagerbridge integration if proxy fails, 3) postmortem and update runbook with handoff checklist and how to trigger fallback. i'll own the P0 postmortem.
emily: timeline: detected 11:12 UTC, proxy OOM and egress blocked ~11:14, manual fallback at 11:18, pages delivered 11:19.
sara: i've scheduled a short incident review at 14:00 UTC and added stakeholders (infra, sRE, support).
maria: thanks everyone — major customer impact avoided thanks to quick manual fallback. we'll need a writeup for CS.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: paging integration failure resolved (root cause: outbound egress deny + proxy OOM). Postmortem owner: jonathan.
emily: closing the thread after the follow-up tasks are triaged. feel free to DM if anything new shows up.
